---
title: Costs and Getting Access
---

## How to request access
In order to use Snellius you need an account and SBUs (System Billing Units). The [SURF wiki](https://servicedesk.surf.nl/wiki/spaces/WIKI/pages/300974109/Accounting) provides some guidance on estimating the amount of SBUs you need. 

### Project space
Each Snellius account is provided with 200GB Home space (backups available), apart from that 8TB of temporary fast _scratch_ space is available for your calculations. If the Home space is not sufficient or you can request _Project Space_ to store your data during your project. Note that the _Project Space_ is not backed-up! Always make sure a copy of valuable data is also stored on a [recommended storage system](/topics/data-storage.qmd). The [SURF wiki](https://servicedesk.surf.nl/wiki/spaces/WIKI/pages/85295828/Storage) has an overview of the storage options.

To obtain SBUs and Project Space there are 3 options:

### 1. Direct institute contract

The VU has a contract with SURF for the usage of Snellius. Every VU researcher or master student can request. The total amount available to the VU is limited however, there are strict limits on GPU SBUs:

- As a researcher you can request up to 300.000 GPU SBUs per person, per year.

- As a student you can request up to 50.000 GPU SBUs per person, per year. 

Start with the default 50.000 CPU and/or GPU SBUs. You can use the same form to request a top-up if you run out.

Only applications with a valid VU email address will be approved. Students must also provide the name of their supervisor.

Request access via a form on the 🔒[SURF service desk portal](https://servicedesk.surf.nl). 

### 2. NWO Small compute grant
For projects needing up to 1.000.000 CPU and/or 1.000.000 GPU SBUs researcher can apply for an [NWO Small Compute grant](https://www.surf.nl/en/small-compute-applications-nwo). Note that you can only make one application per year. Students can ask their supervisor to apply.

Request access via a form on the 🔒[SURF service desk portal](https://servicedesk.surf.nl).

### 3. NWO large compute grant 

If you have a large project involving more than 1.000.000 CPU and/or GPU SBUs you should apply for an [NWO Large Compute applications grant](https://www.surf.nl/en/large-compute-applications-nwo). Note that you can only make one application per year.

## Large-scale GPU projects
Note that for large-scale GPU projects access the European [LUMI](https://www.surf.nl/en/services/lumi) supercomputer can also be requested by VU researchers. [Obtaining compute time on LUMI](https://servicedesk.surf.nl/wiki/display/WIKI/Obtaining+compute+time).

## Are there costs involved?
There are no direct costs for researchers, but be aware that "Direct institute contract" usage costs are billed to the faculties via KDM ("Kosten Doorbelasting Model").
